# Padma Gnanapriya

> Full-Stack Software Engineer and Associate Technical Lead at Velaris, based in Sri Lanka. 5+ years of software engineering experience — including 4.5+ years building enterprise B2B SaaS end-to-end across React, Node.js and AWS — specialising in scalable, cost-optimized cloud platforms and performance engineering. Available for select freelance web development.
